title: Irish Apple Crumble
description: A traditional Irish dessert featuring tender apples topped with a crumbly oat mixture.

ingredients.name: Irish Yeast Biscuits (or substitute with regular biscuits)

instructions: Peel, core, and slice the apples, and place them in a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the granulated sugar, brown sugar, and cinnamon. Sprinkle the mixture evenly over the apples.
To make the crumble topping, combine the crumble, flour, and cold butter in a bowl. Rub the butter into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Spread the crumble mixture evenly over the apples.
Bake the apple crumble for 40-45 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Serve warm, topped with Irish yeast biscuits (or substitute with regular biscuits).
